resveratrol arrests CEM-C7 cells in the S-phase which is followed by apoptosis, and that this process does not involve Fas and caspase 8.
resveratrol induces arrest in the S phase prior to apoptosis in p16/INKA4a-negative CEM-C7HL cells.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
resveratrol causes S-phase arrest followed by apoptosis in CEM C7H2 cells.
resveratrol arrests the S-phase and causes caspase-activated apoptosis in CEM lymphocytic leukemia cells which is Fas-independent and caspase-mediated.

The main takeaway from our work is that
resveratrol induces apoptosis in a p53-independent fashion and that this is not mediated through Fas.
resveratrol induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in CEM cells through a mechanism that involves the activation of caspases-3, -2 and -6.
resveratrol is not a Fas-dependent apoptogen, but rather an S-phase arrest and Fas-independent apoptogen.
